step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates ContactSuite's omnichannel contact center platform on AWS. Visual components show three main paths: 1) Caller Carrie initiates Chat/Voice to Amazon Connect, which triggers Lambda, calling microservices in ECS to interact with external CRMs. 2) Email flows from Caller Carrie through SES to Lambda and persists in DynamoDB. 3) Agent Andy accesses ContactSuite via a Browser using 2FA, backed by EC2/ELB/ASG infrastructure and SenseIQ knowledge base, which stores data in Amazon RDS.
